title: Comfort Club Member Premium Discount Line on After-Hours Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
On Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a Comfort Club member whose agreement is active on the completion date of an Evening, Weekend, Overnight Emergency or Holiday Emergency call is owed a member premium discount on that call's after-hours premium. It is posted as one member premium discount line naming the premium line and the agreement, and it lowers the balance owing on the call. A customer without an active agreement receives no member premium discount.

## Posting tool: `post_member_premium_discount_f1d91bca`

**What it does.** The tool posts a Comfort Club member discount against the after-hours premium line of one service call's invoice, lowering the amount the customer owes on that call. Each call of the tool adds one `member_premium_discount` line to the call's invoice, dated today, naming the premium line it reduces and the Comfort Club agreement whose benefit applies. The call's invoice balance is lowered by exactly the amount given. The tool does not check eligibility or amounts; it books what it is given.

**How it is invoked.** This is a hidden agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it by the name `post_member_premium_discount_f1d91bca`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | Reference number of the service call | Id, read from the service call lookup |
| `source_line_id` | Reference number of the after-hours premium line the discount reduces | Id, read from the call's invoice lines |
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the account holder | Id, read from the customer profile lookup |
| `agreement_id` | Reference number of the customer's Comfort Club agreement | Id, read from the agreement lookup |
| `recall_of_ticket_id` | Reference number of the earlier call this visit returns to under the repair guarantee, copied from the call record | Id; an empty string when the call record shows no earlier call |
| `amount` | The discount being posted | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; a value with more decimals is rounded to the cent half up when booked |

**Return.** The tool returns a receipt with `line_id` (reference number of the new discount line), `ticket_id`, `line_type` (always `member_premium_discount`), `source_line_id`, `agreement_id`, `recall_of_ticket_id` (as passed), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `ticket_balance` (the call's invoice balance in USD after the discount). A receipt carrying a `line_id` means the discount is on the invoice. The discount shows at once among the call's invoice lines and in the call's new balance.
